dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> appears to have something on her mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Miss Hedvika, how are you liking the fishing rod you asked us to get for you last time?

dialogues.speaker: Hedvika
dialogues.text: Oh hey, Miss Jahoda! I really should thank all of you for that. The fishing rod is excellent. I've caught so many fish with it!

dialogues.speaker: Hedvika
dialogues.text: Waant to try the rod out? I just put together some great bait. Use it, and you'll be landing the big fish in no time.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Really? Heh, I'll try it out then! What perfect timing. I've been wanting to learn how to fish!

dialogues.speaker: Hedvika
dialogues.text: No problem, just wait a moment. I'll go get some information for you...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: By the way, Miss Hedvika, how long does it usually take to hook a fish?

dialogues.speaker: Hedvika
dialogues.text: I've never really noticed... And sometimes, when I'm fishing, the afternoon just passes by in the blink of an eye.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Huh. But surely you'd notice the moment you have a fish bite?

dialogues.speaker: Hedvika
dialogues.text: Well, but it's also quite normal to go an entire afternoon without having a bite on the line.

dialogues.speaker: Hedvika
dialogues.text: You know, rather than "catching fish," I'm actually more interested in the process of fishing.

dialogues.speaker: Hedvika
dialogues.text: Hey, Miss Jahoda! Don't leave just yet, I just found you your info.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Um... I... I just remembered there's something I have to attend to. I'll see you again, then...
